title: Usage examples
responsibility: Shows documented examples as short titles and code with expected output comments.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.documentation
inputs.description: The documentation read from this entity at the selected commit, supplying its examples, optional setup and optional gap reason. Without documentation, only the 'No usage examples are documented at this commit.' notice shows; the gap reason shows beneath that notice only when there are no examples, and the Markdown text and path are never rendered.

examples.name: Refuse a registration that does not say who the agent is

error.name: ExpectedCliError
error.message: --label must say who the agent is.

examples.name: Finish with an outcome
examples.call:
// Resolves with no value, shown as null.
await agents.finish(agentId, false, "Service examples documented")

examples.name: Fresh sample
examples.call:
activityReading(
  { tracking: "available", working: 0, unreadable: 0, roster: [] },
  "2026-10-11T12:00:00Z",
  Date.parse("2026-10-11T12:00:05Z")
).current

examples.gap: The document is not available at this commit.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.setupTitle
inputs.description: Heading shown once above the documented setup code, instead of repeating that code before each example; it matters only when examples are documented, and an empty string counts as absent. When setupTitle is given without a documented setup, the note 'How to create it is not documented at this commit.' shows instead of a heading.

outputs.name: EntityExamples
outputs.description: Markup of each documented example's title and code, with its expected output or thrown error as a comment, and the documented setup under the setupTitle heading or before each call. Without documented examples it shows only the 'No usage examples are documented at this commit.' notice, followed by the documentation's gap reason when one is present.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown while formatting an example when a BigInt appears in its output or error, or in its input when the example has no call, because JSON serialization cannot format it.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown while formatting an example whose value contains itself or nests deeper than the call stack allows, because the formatter recurses without a limit.

errors.name: Value access or conversion error
errors.description: Thrown when a getter or Proxy trap on an example or on the documentation throws while it is read, and that error propagates unchanged.
